newsitem.title: UK: Retailer C&A to sponsor MTV's "Turned on Europe".
newsitem.headline: Retailer C&A to sponsor MTV's "Turned on Europe".

text.p: C&A, the retail clothing chain, said on Friday it would sponsor for a second consecutive year MTV Europe's "Turned on Europe" programming.

"By extending our relationship with MTV Europe, C&A is underlining its commitment to and focus on the youth market," Jaap Bosman, national advertising director of C&A, said in a statement released in London.

During summer 1997 MTV will take to the road throughout Europe, filming young people as they seek to capture their attitudes and opinions on style and image, icons and cults, and trends and politics which influence fashion choices.
The video footage will be used for a week of special "Turned on Europe" programming in September.
C&A said it will give extensive support to the project, including advertising on MTV and in-store material.
